title: Concept: Apache mod_status page disclosed in a response
description: The Apache mod_status page renders the running request table: client address, request line, virtual host and worker state for every in-flight connection. It is a live view of who is using the service and which internal hosts are behind it.
applicability: Responses served by Apache httpd with mod_status enabled on a public virtual host.
risk: Live traffic and internal hostnames are readable; MEDIUM severity because the data is current rather than historical.
